summary: TFI International Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a quarterly dividend of US $0.47 per common share, payable July 15, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration by the board with no special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change. The filing does not involve any merger components, advisors, or regulatory clocks. It is a standard quarterly event and not a special situation.
